parameters.content:
## RNA-seq 2.1 / 3.0 integration
Deploy the supplied release-3.0 source bundle first.
Edit Settings and the host request JSON; start with dry_run.
Select an SSH private-key credential on ALL THREE SSH nodes.
Source SHA256 is checked before launch; no old-checkout fallback.

Routes: bulk Salmon/STAR, QuantSeq FWD/REV/UMI, animal/plant small RNA; independent raw QC.
Snakemake chooses the configured route. Unimplemented assays stay blocked.
Stopping n8n does NOT cancel remote work.
